name: vtable
meaning: 0x5744DC holds ONE slot (0x421750 scalar deleting dtor); 0x421BC0 and 0x421DE0 belong to the adjacent vtables 0x5744E0 (VideoPlayer) and 0x5744E4 (checked against the image)

name: format
meaning: Heap-allocated format block filled by the header parser 0x421A20; free()d by the dtors. NULL means 'not opened' and is the guard both CreateFromWave paths test.

name: hmmio
meaning: (HMMIO) The multimedia file handle from mmioOpenA (MMIO_ALLOCBUF, or an in-memory 'MEM ' IOProc). [typed as the SDK handle type HMMIO__ * so it can be passed to the mmio imports]

name: ckData
meaning: The 'data' chunk descriptor (20 bytes, 0x0C..0x1F). WaveFile_ReadMmio decrements its cksize as a bytes-remaining counter, and WaveFile_ResetFile re-descends to restore it. [embedded MMCKINFO (overlay MMCKINFO.csv); the split cksize/dwDataOffset/dwFlags rows are now its members]

name: ckRiff
meaning: The RIFF/WAVE parent chunk descriptor (20 bytes, 0x20..0x33), filled by the header parser 0x421A20.
